newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Ivorian president leaves for Rome visit.
newsitem.headline: Ivorian president leaves for Rome visit.

text.p: Ivory Coast President Henri Konan Bedie left Abidjan for Rome on Monday to preside at ceremonies on October 16 marking the U.N. Food and Agriculture Organisation's World Food Day, officials said.
Bedie was invited by the Rome-based agency's director-general, Senegalese Jacques Diouf, but aides said the president would also hold talks with Italian officials.
Bedie spent nearly two months in Europe between last May and July, mainly in France but also in Italy, where he was received by Pope John Paul.
